formula.label: Walk order / 100 (assumed operational rule, not a prediction)
formula.expression: min(100, place type + compactness + homes nearby)

compactness.expression: 35 × max(0, 1 − distance to the walk centre / 350 m)

formula.missing: No case counts are used. Places without a verified location are left out, never estimated.

landuse_note: URA Master Plan 2025 zoning (planned use): parks and open space in green, water bodies in blue.
footprint_note: Official HDB footprints. Estimated height = published max_floor_lvl × 2.8 m + 1.3 m roof allowance (the NUS Urban Analytics Lab HDB 3D convention), not a surveyed height. Blocks without a verified storey count stay flat; non-HDB buildings are not modelled. Places to check, not confirmed breeding sites.

method.height_reference: Biljecki (2020), NUS Urban Analytics Lab hdb3d: 2.8 m floor-to-floor + 1.3 m roof
